points.title: 出生与成长
points.description: 关汉卿出生于大都，这里是元朝的都城，也是当时中国戏曲的中心。他在这里度过了童年和青少年时期，受到了戏曲艺术的熏陶。关汉卿的成长经历为他后来的戏曲创作奠定了基础，他接触到了丰富的民间文化，这在他的作品中得到了体现。
points.descriptionEn: Guan Hanqing was born in Dadu, which was the capital of the Yuan Dynasty and the center of Chinese opera at the time. He spent his childhood and adolescence here, receiving the influence of opera art. Guan Hanqing's growth experience laid the foundation for his later opera creation, and he was exposed to rich folk culture, which was reflected in his works.

points.title: 戏曲创作
points.description: 关汉卿在大都开始了他的戏曲创作生涯。他的作品以深刻的社会内容和精湛的艺术技巧著称，成为元曲的代表人物。他的代表作《窦娥冤》就是在这一时期创作的，这部作品深刻揭露了封建社会的黑暗面，展现了窦娥的悲惨遭遇和反抗精神。
points.descriptionEn: Guan Hanqing began his career in opera creation in Dadu. His works are known for their profound social content and exquisite artistic skills, making him a representative figure of Yuan opera. His masterpiece 'Dou E's冤' was created during this period, which deeply exposes the dark side of the feudal society and shows Dou E's tragic plight and spirit of resistance.

points.title: 戏曲改革与传承
points.description: 关汉卿在戏曲改革方面做出了重要贡献。他提倡戏曲要贴近生活，反映现实，推动了戏曲艺术的进一步发展。他的作品对后世戏曲创作产生了深远的影响，被后人尊称为‘曲圣’。关汉卿的戏曲作品至今仍在中国各地上演，成为中华民族文化的重要组成部分。
points.descriptionEn: Guan Hanqing made significant contributions to the reform of opera. He advocated that opera should be close to life and reflect reality, promoting the further development of opera art. His works have had a profound impact on the creation of opera in later generations and are respectfully called 'the Saint of Opera'. Guan Hanqing's opera works are still performed in various parts of China today, becoming an important part of the Chinese national culture.

supporter.zh: 关汉卿被誉为‘曲圣’，他的戏曲作品深刻揭示了社会现实，具有很高的艺术成就。他的作品对后世戏曲创作产生了深远的影响，是中国戏曲艺术的瑰宝。
supporter.en: Guan Hanqing is hailed as the 'Saint of Opera', whose works deeply reveal the social reality and have high artistic achievements. His works have had a profound impact on the creation of opera in later generations and are treasures of Chinese opera art.

critic.zh: 关汉卿的作品虽然具有很高的艺术成就，但也存在一些局限性，如过分强调戏剧效果，有时忽视了人物性格的深度。
critic.en: Although Guan Hanqing's works have high artistic achievements, they also have some limitations, such as overemphasizing the dramatic effect, sometimes neglecting the depth of character personalities.

objective.zh: 关汉卿是中国戏曲史上的重要人物，他的作品不仅反映了元朝社会的现实，也体现了中国戏曲艺术的独特魅力。他在戏曲改革和传承方面的贡献，使他成为中国戏曲文化的象征。
objective.en: Guan Hanqing is an important figure in the history of Chinese opera, whose works not only reflect the reality of the Yuan Dynasty society but also embody the unique charm of Chinese opera art. His contributions to the reform and inheritance of opera make him a symbol of Chinese opera culture.

self.zh: “文章合为时而著，歌诗合为事而作。”
self.en: ‘The writing should be in accordance with the times, and the songs and poems should be created for specific events.’

others.en: ‘Guan Hanqing's talent is unparalleled in the world.’
